description: 101 TRAIL! plans your entire hiking and camping trip from start to finish. Get a complete day-by-day itinerary with trails, campgrounds, campsites, driving routes, and nearby towns, matched to your fitness level, difficulty, and the scenery you want. 101 TRAIL! covers the full plan: maps, trailheads, permits, gear checklists, food and water stops, best seasons, and backup options for weather. From easy day hikes to multi-day backpacking treks and national park adventures. Just describe your trip and get a ready-to-go outdoor plan — not just the trail, but the whole journey around it: how to get there, where to sleep, what to pack, and what to do if the weather turns.
